acceptanceCriteria: Release build jobs cannot consume platform helpers before the release_tools producer has completed; a regression asserts the dependency.
Source quality restores executable permissions after artifact download and validates the shared gate tool before expensive checks; a regression asserts the path contract.
The release-close embedded Bash is syntax-checked by the earliest release policy and produces a structured failed receipt when upstream jobs are skipped or inputs are absent.
The existing immutable v0.2.91 tag remains bound to e48a887d24f5e1a640ef9b043b60f6c4dca23a31; no tag movement or Release overwrite occurs.
Reviewed hosted CI passes, the corrected release path publishes v0.2.91, and public downloaded-artifact install and N-1 upgrade acceptance pass with cleanup evidence.
The workflow policy test extracts and syntax-checks the release-close script and rejects missing release_tools dependency or missing post-download chmod before hosted execution.
goal: Make dependency, artifact-path, shell-diagnostic, and release rerun behavior deterministic; pass reviewed hosted checks and public downloaded-artifact acceptance for v0.2.91.
intent: Repair the v0.2.91 release orchestration defects found in the immutable failed tag run and complete the existing tag release without retagging.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Every build matrix entry waits for the release_tools producer before downloading its helper.
The shared Rust gate binary is executable after preflight artifact download.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Recovery publishes only when the requested tag digest matches the candidate and never moves or overwrites the tag or Release.
